Recap Time!

And boy, do we need one. Terribly sorry it's been so long since some of you had turns; after this recap the rest of the updates shouldn't be hard to do and I'll be able to do them despite being more busy now. My tentative goal is to update at least once every two days. Let's see if I can get this thing moving at a good pace from now on; things are getting interesting!

Before anyone could react, a wormhole opened up and a temporally-displaced jsz2 appeared, completing the sword strike he started last round instantly! Before BlueHairedMeerkat could work out what was happening, his faithful partner Magnebro was cut down so harshly its HP technically went NEGATIVE. Not content to cheat continuity just once, Jsz2's Magical Girl enhanced the move and created a double time loop! Jsz2 acted twice at a time when he shouldn't have acted at all! He used the extra time to accumulate cards.

Phantaskippy used Silverleaf's signature move to make everyone assume he had permission to always use his Pochimera, even on other people's turns! It whiped itself up into a frenzy of energy( er, card)-draining and toxin-slinging. However, the extra exertion really didn't do anything to help Weepinoom's poisoning, which started weakening it significantly faster.

BlueHairedMeerkat thought that traveling to Soviet Russia was really fun, and decided to take everyone on another journey: A mobile defense platform containing another mobile defense platform containing another mobile defense platform! The recursion started trippling every played card's effect.

Ronway turned into a ghost, stealing cards from phantaskippy.

Silverleaf missed her turn.

jsz2 used their Tentatortle to put an end to Just Assume I'm Always Doing That. They also pulled me into the game somehow, gaining three more card plays in the process. They then channeled Ronway's power to clone himself, replacing the next turns of Humble-Knight, phantaskippy, and BlueHairedMeerkat. Next, jsz2 summoned an army of Gene-Bound Bunnies, which began multiplying exponentially. They attacked the same three players. Finally, they pulled out even more rodents and handed the spiny things to Ronway, Phantaskippy, and Silverleaf. The hedghogs' painful pricks caused them to lose their hands.

Humble-Knight's turn got replaced by jsz2, who realized he'd been pretty mean to everyone, and just gave everybody 9000 points to make up for it.

At the end of the round, phantaskippy's Weepinoom survived the poisoning! It faded away!

posts.cooked:
Alright!  I'm going to take Phantaskippy and BlueHairedMeerkat's turns in a row so in order to save on time.

Turn 1: Let's be Fwends!

First, my bunnies multiply.  I'm not sure whether the three bunnies made by the first bunny are affected by recursive engineering.  If they are, then I get 12 new bunnies.  If not, I get 6 new bunnies.

Now it's finally time for all of us to become

 

I use 25 more cuteness points to choose two players, rather than one player.  Recursive Engineering then takes effect, so I play Fwends three times.  The first time make me friends with Humble-Knight and Phantaskippy.  The second makes me friends with BlueHairedMeerkat and Silverleaf, and the third makes me friends with Ronway and Alex (if Pile on the Squid is still active).  

Now a water-gun bounces

back to whoever's hand the card came from.

(Wow.  Typing without using I,J,K, and L is harder than I expected.  Thank goodness for Humble-Knight's Slowfable.)

Incidentally, I should be loosing points for not talking in Iambic Ubbi Dubbi, but the point losses are convinently canceled by Ronway of Not Caring, so I'm not caring.

Now, my indeterminent number of bunnies deals an indeterminent amount of life loss to some of us, but it's all canceled by the Ronway of Not Caring, so I don't care.

Now we don't have any opponents, which would make the game a bit boring.  But I have a solution!

 

Turn 2:  Attack of the Platypodes

First off, all the bunnies make more bunnies.  We should now either have 64 or 24 bunnies, I'm not sure which.

Suddenly, a

Appears!

Only, because of recursive engineering, three platypodes appear!

Then our bunnies start attacking the platypodes.  I'll distribute the damage as evenly as possible, which is either 1,600 damage to each platypus or 225 damage to one platypus and 200 damage to the other two.

Also, we and the dragoneot loose points due to poisonpowder, but we don't care about that, either.

 

Also, I think we have a combined total of 64,254 points.

 

Also (again), I'm now very sorry I made you discard Just Assume I'm always doing that, Phantaskippy.  It would have worked well with Fwends to create a bunnysplosion,
